headline: Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions announces new equipment purchase
hook: New asset addition at Tara Chand
summary: Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions Limited has informed the stock exchange about the acquisition of new equipment. The disclosure was made through a routine regulatory filing. Specific financial details or the exact nature of the equipment were not provided in the announcement. Retail investors may note this as minor operational expansion.
why_it_matters: Routine equipment addition with negligible impact on stock price
